reuse.why: Reuses findOrCreateBank and shares account linking, transaction downloading, and local unlinking across existing providers and Fintegra.

duplication.why: Removes repeated provider workflows and centralizes link validation and takeover without introducing duplicated decision logic.

placement.why: Database link queries remain in link.ts, handler orchestration stays in app.ts, and provider downloads remain in sync.ts.

scope.why: Changes are focused on the requested linking rules and Fintegra integration, including the necessary provider types and configuration.

maintainability.why: Small provider adapters feed shared workflows, while one guard consistently applies linking policies to every registered provider.

bypasses_abstraction.where: All six link handlers use guardBankAccountLink, and takeover shares clearBankLink with unlinkAccount while intentionally excluding provider disconnection.

disguised_duplication.where: Repeated linking and downloading implementations are replaced by shared functions rather than renamed or reshaped copies.

abstraction_drift.where: LinkAccountBaseParams adds replaceExistingLink, with one corresponding policy branch in guardBankAccountLink; every provider uses that shared guard.
